root_cause: The header component incorrectly applies aria-hidden='true' to the navigation menu when the menu button is collapsed, hiding the navigation links from assistive technology on desktop widths where the menu should be visible.
repair_strategy: Remove the aria-hidden attribute synchronization in Header.prototype.syncState, relying on CSS (display:none/show) to control visibility of the navigation menu, which already hides it appropriately in mobile view and shows it on desktop.
expected_accessibility_effect: Navigation links will be exposed in the accessibility tree with role link and accessible names, allowing keyboard and screen‑reader users to reach and activate them via Tab.
functional_risks: If CSS changes or fails, the navigation could remain accessible when visually hidden on mobile, but the existing CSS rule display:none on .govuk-header__navigation when the menu is closed ensures it is removed from the accessibility tree.
verification_requirements: Assert that axe role link checks pass for #nav-apply, #nav-renew, and #nav-rules.
Verify that the menu button's aria-expanded attribute toggles correctly when clicked.
Confirm that on narrow viewports the navigation is hidden (not in the accessibility tree) when the menu button is collapsed.
Confirm that on wide viewports the navigation is visible and accessible without needing to open the menu button.
